paragraphs: A developer from the start, and still in the code: the architecture, the people building it, and what it takes to reach production.
The technical voice with the client, from the first estimate to the steering meeting, including system integrators and delivery partners.

about.pdfSummary: More than fifteen years in software, starting as a developer. For more than ten years, leading as well as building, and for over five of those years technical direction was the core of the job. Dozens of clients, from fashion and retail to banking and insurance, and work with system integrators and delivery partners. The technical voice with the client, from pre-sales estimates and proposals to steering meetings, and accountable for production after go-live. Hiring interviews, and evaluation of people’s performance and results.
